reviewContext.issueReference: Round-4 CAD and AI capture audit, 0a35708..audit/round-4@3f9ce78b9599d35945a7e29fb449a5ca3e89b431; no GitHub issue; workflowInput.requestedOutcome is the issue body
reviewContext.userProblem: The round-4 audit found eight defects in 3D CAD pages and AI capture: a shared cut that the app rejects because it empties a hidden target is captured as if it succeeded; repeated raster attachments are embedded once per placement in 2D capture; loop normalization, swept-extent checks and concave ear clipping do quadratic work; missing-glyph warnings for group and frame targets name elements outside the image; and NMESH validation and CAD face resolution each have two owners that can drift.
requiredOutcomes: function-capture-hidden-target-empty-cut (R4-1; f1a, f1b, f1c, f1d): with interference off, the two-target capture draws only wide and reports trim as a sampled cad.result.empty against wide; the visible-only control reports none; scenes differ; bytes of scenes without hidden targets unchanged.

performance-capture-repeated-attachment-svg-expansion (R4-2; f2a, f2b): one carrier payload and one read per distinct attachment; renderer input grows only by placement markup at the native and Bun boundaries; PNG parity with independently embedded markup for PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP (WebP unresolved on Bun as today); native JPG parity; standalone export unchanged.

performance-capture-loop-normalization-pair-scans (R4-3; f3): rings, diagonal-strip and mixed fixtures meet the 2.5x doubling and 17N entry bounds; probes never exceed today; oracle loops and NCS1 bytes equal.
performance-cad-repeated-swept-extent-scans (R4-4; f4): vertex projections independent of extrusion count; bounds bit-equal; 10,000 mm boundary and error precedence unchanged.

performance-cad-concave-preview-ear-scans (R4-5; f5): candidateVisits grows at most 2.5x per doubling on the fixed notch series in both windings; ordered triangles equal the oracle; preview bytes unchanged.
maintainability-capture-glyph-attribution-scope (R4-6; f6a, f6b): capture and raster export use one membership helper; group and frame targets warn only inside ids; whole page unchanged.
maintainability-nmesh-typescript-validation-owners (R4-7; f7): one readNmesh owns the rules; the capture budget follows inspection.vertexCount; errors, counts and bounds agree across modes.
maintainability-cad-face-resolution-rules (R4-8; f8): one single-feature update used by both lookups; parity on valid, suppressed and broken chains; profile-build count unchanged.
nonGoals: No edits to crates/capture/src/raster.rs, crates/capture/src/raster/**, crates/capture/src/prism.rs, crates/capture/src/cast.rs, capture goldens or docs/capture.md.
No golden regeneration, no error code or message changes outside the new hidden-target text, no package boundary changes.
constraints: AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, strict typing, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true, rustfmt on touched Rust files.
Each plan uses CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/<planId> and artifactRoots ["target", "tmp/cad3d"].
Per-plan gates are focused; typecheck, lint, mise run verify and mise run test-cli run once at integration.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: NCS1 offset 36 counts trailing hidden body records.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Version 1 kept; zero hidden targets gives identical bytes; hidden bodies never enter bodies.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Hidden census runs in lib.rs after render_rgb.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: raster.rs is protected and builds BodyReport and Report.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Capture embeds one <defs> carrier per attachment; placements use https://nodetto.invalid/capture-asset/<n>.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Same image elements and ImageKind give byte parity; resvg-js reports only HTTPS hrefs.
resvg-js 2.6.2 omits inline WebP and throws on resolveImage for WebP.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Loop index with 16-cell replication cap and merged bucket-order query.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Linear construction for any overlap; never more probes than today.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Ear test walks only non-strictly-convex live vertices.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Exact for simple polygons, which loops.ts guarantees; box indexes failed the gate.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Per-loop extrema memoised by points array and frame.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Exact by monotonic rounding; one projection per loop per frame.
Remove duplicated rules named by the maintainability findings.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-25 round 1: authorize the native parity suite's generated timing files tmp/capture/m09/timing.json and tmp/capture/m23/timing.json as exact car4-f1d-hidden-census writePaths; the other 12 plans are recorded as acceptedDependencies and only car4-f1d-hidden-census is redispatched.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Blocked plan car4-f1d-hidden-census (blocked-wave-scope-or-contract): apps/cli/src/native-parity/capture.test.ts:178, 315-319 and 745-750 write those two files outside artifactRoots and writePaths. Resolved by exact file authorization with no glob, no test redirection and artifactRoots unchanged; the partial census.rs, lattice.rs, report.rs and lib.rs edits resume per the plan's amendment section, with both gates run unchanged.

intentionalTradeoffs: Hidden census at most doubles census rays, only for scenes with hidden targets of shared cuts.
Ear-test exactness relies on the simple-polygon precondition of its only production caller.
supportedEdgeCases: Scenes without hidden targets, SVGs without carriers, WebP attachments on Bun, collinear and comb polygons, multi-byte NMESH counts at and above budget, suppressed and broken face chains.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Reproducing the app's skip-and-fail-dependents behavior in capture; non-simple polygons passed directly to triangulateSimplePolygon.

acceptedDependencies.provides: Capture scene carries hidden Boolean targets of shared cuts (NCS1 offset 36 hidden count, trailing hidden records) without drawing them (R4-1).
Rust NCS1 reader exposes Scene.hidden: Vec<Body>, kept out of bodies (R4-1).
parseSolidReport accepts hiddenEmptiedByStep; describeBodies reports a sampled cad.result.empty on the visible body (R4-1).
Native renderer resolves capture-asset carriers with PNG/JPG byte parity (R4-2).
2D capture embeds one carrier payload per distinct attachment (R4-2).
Indexed loop normalization with subquadratic ancestor probes (R4-3).
Per-loop extrema memoised per frame for extent validation and bounds (R4-4).
Ear test walks only non-strictly-convex live vertices (R4-5).
Shared attributeTargetGlyphs scoped to the rendered container for capture and raster export (R4-6).
Single readNmesh owner; capture budget follows inspection.vertexCount (R4-7).
Single resolveFeatureGeometry update shared by cached and one-shot lookups (R4-8).

acceptanceCriteria: render_parsed JSON has "hiddenEmptiedByStep":1 on wide for the two-target scene with options 0; the control JSON equals today's to_json; threads 1 and 5 equal; exhausted allowance adds no key.
resolve_with results and raster reference comparisons unchanged.
Native CLI --no-interference: two-target document prints errors: 1 with the trim hidden-target line naming wide; control prints errors: 0; only wide listed in bodies.
